I wanted to visit once more.
strings.그러셨구나. 제 일은 별거 아니에요. 신경 쓰지 않으셔도 돼요. 후아아아: I see. It's nothing important. Don't worry about me. Siiigh...
Now I'm worried. Please tell me.
strings.그게 아니고, 원로들께서 이번에 플라티나 후배님에게 선물 같은 걸 주려고: Well, the elders want to give my junior, Platina, a present. And they've told me to choose it!
strings.그걸 왜 아우룸이 골라요?: Why do you have to choose?
Exactly! What if the gift makes things between us even more awkward, beyond repair...?
We haven't been able to cut loose together. Ugh...
strings.그러면 그냥 물어보고 좋아하는 걸 주면 되지 않을까요?: Why not just ask what she likes and give her that?
I'd like to, but I can't leave the Sanctuary for a while.
strings.…선물을 고를 때까지는 나가지 말라고 하셔서요. 저기, 모험가님…. 같이: ...They told me not to leave until I've chosen a gift. Adventurer... For the sake of your fellow troublemaker, could you help?
strings.플라티나 후배님이 어디에 있는지는 알고 있어요. 죄송합니다!: I know where Platina is. I'm sorry!
strings.…어쩔 수 없죠. 플라티나는 어디에 있죠?: ...I suppose I have no choice. Where is she?
strings.플라티나 후배님은 아직도 모로스 지역에 남아있어요. 폐하의 명으로 뭔가를: She's still in the Moros region. I think she's investigating something else on Her Majesty's orders.
Near the Magic Shelter, then. I'll go and ask her.
Thank you! All that rampaging together really paid off.
strings.(물어보러 간 김에 플라티나와 이야기해 봐야지….): (I'll have a proper conversation with Platina while I'm there...)
Oh, Adventurer? What brings you here...?
strings.이런저런 일들이 있긴 하지만, 괜찮아요. 성역에 있는 아우룸의 부탁을 받: A few things have happened, but I'm all right. Aurum sent me from the Sanctuary.
strings.잠시만요? 성역에서 오셨다고요?: Wait. You came from the Sanctuary?
strings.(플라티나에게 성역에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (I tell Platina what happened at the Sanctuary.)
strings.그런 일이 있었군요. 아우룸 선배님과 아르젠트 님을 도와 성역을 지켜주셔: So that's what happened. Thank you for helping Aurum and Argent protect it.
strings.…그런데 아우룸 선배의 부탁이란 게 뭔가요?: ...What did Aurum ask you to do?
strings.원로들께서 플라티나에게 선물을 주고 싶어 하는데, 고르는 걸 아우룸에게: The elders want to give you a present, and they left choosing it to Aurum. She doesn't know what to pick, so I've come to ask on her behalf.
strings.그렇군요. 흐음. 선물…. 원로회에서 주는 선물…. 뭐가 좋을까요?: I see. Hmm. A gift... A gift from the elders... What would be good?
I've never thought about receiving anything for myself...
Oh! I know. A hair tie. I'd like to tie up my long hair.
strings.선물로 그거면 돼요? 더 좋은 거 받고 싶지 않아요?: Is that all you want? Wouldn't you like something more special?
strings.제가 원하는 건 보통의 것과는 달라요. 미카엘라 님께서 세인트 발키리들에: The one I want isn't ordinary. I'd like the kind Michaela gives the Saint Valkyries.
Something from Michaela must mean a great deal to holy knights.
Yes... She gives them only to those deemed worthy.
Worthy... All right. I'll tell Aurum.
You seem to have something else you wanted to say...
strings.있긴 있었는데, 즐겁게 이야기하다 보니 굳이 지금 이야기할 필요가 있을까: I did, but we've been having such a pleasant conversation, I wondered if it needed to be said now.
strings.그러면 딱 한 가지만 물어볼게요. 폐하는 어떤 분이시죠?: Then I'll ask just one thing. What kind of person is Her Majesty?
strings.후후, 제일 어려운 질문이네요. 다른 사람들보다 워낙 복합적인 면이 많으: Hehe. The hardest question of all. She's a far more complex person than most. You already know about her foresight...
strings.혹시 폐하께서 어떻게 즉위하신지 아세요?: Do you know how she came to the throne?
strings.선황 폐하께서 자신의 후계를 당시 제 1황녀이자 지금의 황제이신 폐하로: The late emperor intended his eldest daughter, our current empress, to succeed him. But a faction opposed a woman taking the throne instead of a man.
strings.그 세력은 선황 폐하께서 승하하신 날에 반란을 일으켰지만, 폐하의 예지: They rebelled on the day the late emperor died. Her Majesty's foresight allowed the rebellion to be suppressed.
strings.반란을 일으킨 세력 뒤에 의회가 있다고 의심되지만, 증거 같은 건 나오지: The council was suspected of backing them, but no evidence was found.
strings.대신 소문이 있었어요. 마족, 마녀, 마법청에서 증거를 없앴다…. 뭐 이: Instead, there were rumors. That demons, witches, or the Magic Bureau had destroyed the evidence... Things like that...
strings.(시이나에게서 들었던 이야기가 떠오르는데….): (This reminds me of what Shiina told me...)
It's already been ten years. Her Majesty seems to have chosen to let the matter rest.
strings.…아, 벌써 시간이…. 모험가님, 저는 할 일이 생겨서 가봐야 할 것 같: ...Oh, look at the time. Adventurer, I have work to do. I'd better go...
Then I'll be going too. I'll tell Aurum what you chose.
strings.(미카엘라 님에게 달라고 하면 되겠네.): (I just need to ask Michaela for it.)
Though I doubt Michaela will just hand it over...
Hello, %s. A greeting from Mica. You'll be safe if you enter the sanctum.
Oh, Michaela, you're here too? Wait... Didn't you go into that red place...?
strings.심심해서 잠깐 나왔어. 여기 있는 쿠키가 미카의 입에 맞아. 미카, 쿠키: I was bored, so I came out for a bit. Mica likes these cookies. I'll go back after eating them.
strings.가실 때 몇 개 담아드릴까요?: Shall I pack some for you to take?
strings.뭔가 상황이 재미있네요. 아, 맞다. 플라티나한테 선물로 뭘 받고 싶은지: This is quite a scene. Oh, right. I asked Platina what she'd like as a gift.
Mica thinks these cookies are delicious.
She'd like the hair tie you give the Valkyries, Michaela.
If Platina wants one, Mica would like to give her one. But I can't give it away for nothing.
She may give them freely to Valkyries, but apparently not to humans.
strings.응, 힐레. 미카와 처음 만났던 그 붉은 색 가득한 장소가 힐레야. 가서: Yes, Hyle. That place full of red where you first met Mica. I'll wait there.
I want to feel your strength again.
strings.아우룸, 쿠키 잘 먹었어. 챙겨준 거 가져갈게. (우물우물): Aurum, thank you for the cookies. I'll take the ones you packed. (Munch, munch.)
strings.(미카엘라가 말이 끝나자마자 밖으로 나가 날개를 펼친다. 쿠키가 든 통을: (Finishing her words, Michaela steps outside and spreads her wings. The sight of an angel flying over Sanctuary Eidos while cradling a tin of cookies is rather peculiar.)
strings.그러니까 그곳에 가서 미카엘라 님과 싸워야 한다는 거죠? 그걸 얻기 위해: So I have to go there and fight her? To get the hair tie...
Yes... That seems to be what she wants.
...I'll go. It'll work out somehow. Sigh...
strings.여기 머리끈, 가지고 있다가 플라티나 주세요. 미카엘라 님께서 봐주셔서: Here's the hair tie. Keep it and give it to Platina. Thank goodness Michaela went easy on me. That was exhausting. She gave me this and vanished before I could even say goodbye.
Michaela got here quite a while ago. She must really like the cookies.
strings.와, 이거…. 제 둔기만큼 엄청나게 신성한 힘이 느껴지네요, 미카엘라 님: Wow... I can feel as much holy power in this as in my mace, Michaela.
strings.가이아 님께서 주신 내 생일 선물이야. (우물우물): It was a birthday present from Gaia. (Munch, munch.)
strings.어, 그렇게 소중한 걸 주셔도 되는 거예요?: Oh, can you really give away something so precious?
...When Mica wants to give one to someone, another grows.
strings.(미카엘라가 머리를 땋은 초록 줄기 머리끈의 일부를 자른다. 잠시 후,: (Michaela cuts a piece from the green stem tying her braided hair. In moments, the cutting in her hand grows into a full-length stem.)
strings.잠깐만요, 미카엘라 님…. 저거 그냥 주실 수도 있던 거죠?: Wait, Michaela... You could have just given it to me?
strings.그러고보니 그렇네요. 미카엘라 님 저한테는 왜 그냥 주셨어요?: Come to think of it, why did you give me one without asking anything?
strings.아우룸은 미카에게 쿠키를 줬어. %s, 너는 주는 게 없어서 대신 내가: Aurum gave Mica cookies. You didn't give me anything, %s, so I asked to spar instead.
strings.아, 저도 쿠키를 드릴 걸…. 다음에 몽글몽글 길드에서 만드는 디저트 같: Oh, I should have brought cookies too... Next time, I'll bring desserts from the Mongle Mongle Guild.
Mica will be waiting. Bring them someday.
Sigh. I should have brought something tasty from the start.
strings.모험가님, 여기 오셔서 같이 쿠키 먹어요. 아르젠트가 글래스턴에서 파는: Adventurer, come have some cookies with us. Argent gave me these special cookies from Glaston.
Mica doesn't need to, but I eat things that taste good.
strings.그렇군요. 그럼 저도 어디 하나만…. 와, 맛있네요. 대체 뭐로 만든 거: I see. Then I'll try one... Wow, this is delicious. What are these made of? Amazing.
...Ah, I wish I could spend every day eating delicious food and cutting loose.
strings.(아우룸처럼 그러는게 최고겠지? 걱정 없이 지내는 거…. 하지만, 할 일: (Living like Aurum would be wonderful, wouldn't it? Without a worry... But I have too much to do for that...)
